name: dripos-mcp

tools.name: drip_whoami
tools.description: Identify the Drip workspace this MCP session is authenticated against. Returns the key type (test/live), business ID, owner email, and any active live-write gate. Agents should call this first to confirm which environment they are in before any state-changing tool.

tools.name: drip_track_usage
tools.description: Record metered usage for tracking (tokens, API calls, compute time, etc.). This logs usage without billing.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for safe retries

tools.name: drip_start_run
tools.description: Start tracking an agent execution run

externalRunId.description: Your external run ID for correlation

tools.name: drip_emit_event
tools.description: Log an event within an active run (LLM call, tool call, etc.)

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for THIS event (e.g. "<runId>:step-3"). Reuse the same key when retrying the same event so it is recorded exactly once.

tools.name: drip_end_run
tools.description: Complete an agent execution run

errorMessage.description: Error message if status is FAILED

tools.name: drip_record_run
tools.description: Record a complete agent run in a single call. This is the recommended way to log runs - it handles workflow creation, run creation, event emission, and run completion automatically.

workflow.description: Workflow/agent name or slug (auto-creates if doesn't exist)

events.description: Array of events that occurred during the run

errorMessage.description: Error message if status is FAILED

externalRunId.description: Your external run ID for correlation

tools.name: drip_get_timeline
tools.description: Get the execution timeline for a run, including all events and computed totals

tools.name: drip_demo_bootstrap
tools.description: One-call hello-world: creates a disposable demo customer, submits one tracking usage event, and returns pointers so the dev can see it in the Drip dashboard. Use when a dev wants to verify the MCP is wired up before real integration work. TEST-MODE ONLY — refuses on sk_live_*/rk_live_* keys regardless of DRIP_ALLOW_LIVE_WRITES (so a prompt-injected agent can't create a real customer on a production workspace).

customerLabel.description: Optional human label for the demo customer, capped at 120 chars (default 'MCP demo')

tools.name: drip_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the current workspace. Paginated (default 25, max 100). Returns customer IDs, external IDs, on-chain addresses (if provisioned), and creation timestamps.

offset.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Advance by adding the previous limit each page.

tools.name: drip_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Provide externalCustomerId (your own customer ID) and optional onchainAddress. Omitting onchainAddress creates an internal customer suitable for off-chain usage tracking. Metadata accepts any JSON object.

externalCustomerId.description: Your DB's own customer ID — used for idempotent upserts and webhook correlation

onchainAddress.description: Ethereum address (0x...40) for on-chain billing. Omit for internal-only customers.

parentId.description: Parent customer ID for hierarchical billing. Parent must belong to the same business.

tools.name: drip_list_pricing_plans
tools.description: List pricing plans for the workspace. Returns plans keyed by unit type (llm_tokens, api_calls, etc.) with unit price, currency, active state.

tools.name: drip_create_pricing_plan
tools.description: Create a pricing plan for a specific unit type. Example: llm_tokens at $0.000002 per token, api_calls at $0.01 per call. The unitPriceUsd is per unit (not per 1000).

unitPriceUsd.description: Price per unit in USD. Numeric strings are coerced; sub-cent pricing is supported up to 6 decimals.

currency.description: ISO currency code; defaults to USD

tools.name: drip_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for the workspace. Filter by status (DRAFT, PENDING, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, VOIDED, OVERDUE) and customerId. Paginated.

tools.name: drip_get_invoice
tools.description: Get a single invoice by ID including line items, totals, taxes, and payment state. PDF downloads are not supported through MCP because `/v1/invoices/:id/pdf` returns binary data; use the dashboard or a direct API client for PDFs.

tools.name: drip_list_charges
tools.description: List charges for the workspace. Charges are the billable records created by /v1/usage (or the batch endpoint) when a pricing plan matches. Filter by customerId, status, or date range.

tools.name: drip_submit_usage
tools.description: Submit a billable usage event. Creates a charge if a pricing plan matches AND the customer has an on-chain address. If the customer has no on-chain address (or is internal), the event is auto-promoted to /usage/internal (tracking-only). Use drip_track_usage if you always want tracking-only semantics. idempotencyKey is required for safe retries.

customerId.description: Drip customer ID. Omit to use externalCustomerId.

externalCustomerId.description: Your DB's customer ID — auto-creates internal Drip customer on first use

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries (required — agents retry on 5xx)

tools.name: drip_bill_on_results
tools.description: Bill a customer based on the number of items returned in a JSON response. Pass the raw response and an optional field path — if the array is empty or missing, no charge is created. Zero-result calls are always free. Perfect for search APIs, list endpoints, or any pay-per-result pattern.

customerId.description: Drip customer ID. Omit to use externalCustomerId.

externalCustomerId.description: Your DB's customer ID — auto-creates a Drip customer on first use

response.description: The raw JSON response to count items from (object or array).

countField.description: Dot-notation path to the array to count (e.g. "results", "data.items"). Omit if the response itself is a top-level array.

usageType.description: Billable metric name that matches your pricing plan (default: "results")

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. Auto-generated if omitted.

metadata.description: Additional metadata attached to the charge

tools.name: drip_list_integrations
tools.description: List marketplace + CRM integrations for the workspace (STRIPE, AWS_MARKETPLACE, AZURE_MARKETPLACE, GCP_MARKETPLACE, SALESFORCE, XERO). Filter by provider. Secrets are never returned.

provider.description: Filter to a specific provider (e.g. STRIPE)

tools.name: drip_test_integration
tools.description: Ping an integration's external provider (Stripe, AWS Marketplace, etc.) and confirm the connection is live. Persists lastTestedAt + status on the integration row. Safe to call on any integration; no side effects on the provider side.

tools.name: drip_connect_stripe
tools.description: Connect a Stripe account via secret API key. Validates the key against Stripe's /v1/account, probes scoped capabilities (tax/billing/invoicing), creates the MarketplaceIntegration row, optionally flips taxProvider to STRIPE_TAX, and returns the webhook URL the merchant must paste into their Stripe dashboard. Idempotent on Stripe accountId — retries with the same account return alreadyExists=true. Requires ADMIN on the Drip key.

apiKey.description: Stripe secret key (sk_live_* or sk_test_*) or restricted key (rk_live_* or rk_test_*). Never logged; redacted at every escape path.

webhookSecret.description: Optional whsec_* webhook signing secret. If omitted, you'll PATCH it in later via drip_api_call PATCH /v1/integrations/:id once you've registered the returned webhook URL in Stripe.

enableStripeTax.description: When true, flips the workspace taxProvider to STRIPE_TAX (uses Stripe Tax for calculations)

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the integration

defaultEventName.description: Default meter event name on Stripe's side (default: drip_usage)

taxApiKey.description: Optional scoped restricted key for Stripe Tax (least-privilege)

billingApiKey.description: Optional scoped restricted key for Stripe Billing

invoicingApiKey.description: Optional scoped restricted key for Stripe Invoicing

tools.name: drip_push_stripe_usage
tools.description: Submit a metered usage record to a connected Stripe integration. Looks up the STRIPE integration for the workspace (via drip_list_integrations), then forwards the usage record via POST /v1/integrations/:id/usage. Returns the Stripe submission receipt so an agent can verify the meter event landed in Stripe. Use after drip_connect_stripe.

externalSubscriptionId.description: REQUIRED for Stripe Billing Meter usage. Pass the Stripe Customer ID (cus_…) here — the field name is historical. Stripe v2 Billing Meters consume a customer mapping, and the connector wires this field into payload[stripe_customer_id]. Backend rejects with MISSING_CUSTOMER if absent.

externalCustomerId.description: Reserved for Stripe invoice-creation flows (createInvoice path), not meter usage. For drip_push_stripe_usage, leave this empty and pass the Stripe Customer ID via externalSubscriptionId instead.

integrationId.description: Skip the lookup and submit to a specific integration directly

tools.name: drip_test_webhook
tools.description: Fire a test event against a registered webhook endpoint and return the delivery result (status code, latency, error). Use to verify the merchant's endpoint is reachable and signing the response correctly.

tools.name: drip_last_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List the most recent webhook deliveries for a webhook, newest first. Each delivery includes the event type, HTTP status from the merchant endpoint, latency, retry count, and (if failed) the error message. The #1 tool for debugging "why did my webhook not fire?"

tools.name: drip_replay_event
tools.description: Replay a previous webhook delivery — same event, same target, fresh HTTP call. Use when a delivery failed (merchant endpoint was down, 5xx'd, etc.) and you want to retry after the merchant fixed their endpoint. Requires the webhookId AND the specific deliveryId (use drip_last_webhook_deliveries to find it).

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID to replay (whd_... from drip_last_webhook_deliveries)

tools.name: drip_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by Drip ID. Returns full record: externalCustomerId, onchainAddress, metadata, creation timestamp, and current balance if provisioned.

tools.name: drip_update_pricing_plan
tools.description: Update an existing pricing plan. Patch any combination of name, unitPriceUsd, isActive, pricingModel, or tiers. Switching to a tier-based model (TIERED/VOLUME/PACKAGE) requires tiers in the same call.

unitPriceUsd.description: Price per unit in USD. Numeric strings are coerced; sub-cent pricing is supported up to 6 decimals.

isActive.description: Set false to deactivate without deleting

pricingModel.description: Pricing model — required tiers when switching to TIERED/VOLUME/PACKAGE

tiers.description: Tier definitions — required when pricingModel is TIERED/VOLUME/PACKAGE

tools.name: drip_delete_pricing_plan
tools.description: Soft-delete (deactivate) a pricing plan. The plan is marked inactive and no longer matches new usage events; historical charges are preserved. Pass the plan ID returned by drip_list_pricing_plans or drip_create_pricing_plan.

tools.name: drip_create_contract
tools.description: Create a per-customer contract with negotiated pricing. Contracts can set a discount, committed spend minimum, spend cap, prepaid balance, and per-unit overrides. Required: customerId, name, startDate (ISO 8601). Admin key required.

endDate.description: Contract end date (ISO 8601); omit for open-ended

discountPct.description: Blanket discount percentage applied to all charges (0–100)

prepaidAmountUsdc.description: Prepaid balance to credit in USD

prepaidRollover.description: Roll unused prepaid balance into next period

includedUnits.description: Free units per usage type, e.g. { llm_tokens: 1000000 }

tools.name: drip_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts. Filter by customerId or status (ACTIVE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED).

tools.name: drip_get_contract
tools.description: Fetch a single contract by ID including all fields, price overrides, and current spend.

tools.name: drip_amend_contract
tools.description: Amend (patch) an existing contract. All fields are optional — only supplied fields are changed. Use to extend end date, raise/lower spend cap, adjust discount, or add prepaid balance.

tools.name: drip_cancel_contract
tools.description: Cancel a contract. Sets status to CANCELLED; in-flight charges already created under the contract are not reversed. Use drip_amend_contract to set an endDate instead if you want graceful expiry.

tools.name: drip_add_contract_price_override
tools.description: Add or replace a per-unit-type price override on a contract. The override applies only to charges for this customer under this contract. unitPriceUsd is a string (e.g. "0.0005") to preserve sub-cent precision.

unitPriceUsd.description: Override price per unit in USD as a string (e.g. "0.0005")

tools.name: drip_remove_contract_price_override
tools.description: Remove a per-unit-type price override from a contract, reverting to the default pricing plan rate.

unitType.description: Usage unit type to remove the override for

tools.name: drip_create_entitlement_plan
tools.description: Create an entitlement plan (a named set of feature quotas). Required: name and slug (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores, e.g. "pro-tier"). Plans are assigned to customers via drip_assign_customer_entitlement.

isDefault.description: Make this the default plan for new customers

tools.name: drip_list_entitlement_plans
tools.description: List all entitlement plans for the workspace, including their rules and active state.

tools.name: drip_get_entitlement_plan
tools.description: Fetch a single entitlement plan by ID including all feature rules.

tools.name: drip_update_entitlement_plan
tools.description: Update an entitlement plan (name, description, isDefault, isActive). Does not modify rules — use drip_create_entitlement_rule / drip_update_entitlement_rule for that.

tools.name: drip_delete_entitlement_plan
tools.description: Soft-delete (deactivate) an entitlement plan. Customers currently assigned this plan retain their assignment but the plan stops being offered to new customers.

tools.name: drip_create_entitlement_rule
tools.description: Add a feature quota rule to an entitlement plan. Required: featureKey (e.g. "api_calls"), limitType (COUNT or AMOUNT), period (DAILY or MONTHLY), limitValue. Set unlimited: true for uncapped access.

planId.description: Entitlement plan ID to add the rule to

limitType.description: COUNT for discrete items, AMOUNT for continuous values

unlimited.description: Set true for uncapped access to this feature

tools.name: drip_list_entitlement_rules
tools.description: List all feature quota rules for an entitlement plan.

tools.name: drip_update_entitlement_rule
tools.description: Update a specific entitlement rule (limitValue or unlimited flag).

unlimited.description: Set true to uncap; false to re-enforce limitValue

tools.name: drip_delete_entitlement_rule
tools.description: Delete a feature quota rule from an entitlement plan.

tools.name: drip_assign_customer_entitlement
tools.description: Assign an entitlement plan to a customer (or update their current assignment). Optional overrides let you give a specific customer different limits than the plan defaults.

tools.name: drip_get_customer_entitlement
tools.description: Fetch a customer's assigned entitlement plan plus their current period usage per feature. Shows remaining quota for each feature key.

tools.name: drip_check_entitlement
tools.description: Fast pre-request entitlement check: is this customer allowed to use this feature, and how much quota remains? Returns { allowed, remaining, resetAt }. Use before gating an expensive operation to avoid charging a customer who is over quota.

quantity.description: Units to consume in this check (default 1)

tools.name: drip_list_webhooks
tools.description: List all registered webhooks for the workspace. Returns endpoint URLs, subscribed event types, active state, and delivery stats.

tools.name: drip_create_webhook
tools.description: Register a new webhook endpoint. Required: url (HTTPS) and at least one event type. Common event types: charge.succeeded, charge.failed, customer.balance.low, invoice.created, contract.created. Call drip_list_webhook_event_types for the full list.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint URL to receive webhook events

description.description: Optional human-readable label for this webhook

tools.name: drip_get_webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook by ID including its subscribed events, active state, and recent delivery stats.

tools.name: drip_update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook — change URL, swap subscribed event types, or toggle isActive. All fields optional; only supplied fields are changed.

isActive.description: Set false to pause deliveries without deleting

tools.name: drip_delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook endpoint. All pending deliveries are cancelled. Use drip_update_webhook with isActive: false to pause without deleting.

tools.name: drip_list_webhook_event_types
tools.description: List all available webhook event types with descriptions. Use this to discover valid event type strings before calling drip_create_webhook or drip_update_webhook.

tools.name: drip_update_business_settings
tools.description: Update business-level settings. All fields optional — only supplied fields are changed. Updatable: defaultCurrency, eventIngestionGracePeriodHours, legalName, taxId, address fields (addressLine1, addressLine2, addressCity, addressRegion, addressPostalCode, addressCountry), phone, website, billingEmail, supportEmail, logoUrl.

defaultCurrency.description: ISO currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, USDC, etc.)

legalName.description: Legal entity name shown in invoice header

taxId.description: EIN, VAT, ABN, or other tax ID

tools.name: drip_set_customer_spending_cap
tools.description: Set a spending cap on a customer. capType: DAILY_CHARGE_LIMIT, MONTHLY_CHARGE_LIMIT, or SINGLE_CHARGE_LIMIT. limitValue is the cap amount in USD. Set autoBlock: true to hard-stop charges when the cap is hit.

autoBlock.description: Hard-block charges when cap is hit (default false = warn only)

tools.name: drip_list_customer_spending_caps
tools.description: List all active spending caps for a customer.

tools.name: drip_remove_customer_spending_cap
tools.description: Remove a specific spending cap from a customer by cap ID (returned by drip_list_customer_spending_caps).

tools.name: drip_list_deal_templates
tools.description: List saved deal templates. Templates are reusable bundles of entitlement rules, pricing plans, and contract terms that sales can apply to prospects in one call.

tools.name: drip_get_deal_template
tools.description: Fetch a single deal template by ID including entitlement config, pricing config, and contract config.

tools.name: drip_create_deal_template
tools.description: Create a reusable deal template. entitlementConfig defines the feature quotas (plan name + slug + rules). pricingConfig defines per-unit pricing. contractConfig is optional and sets discount, commit, prepaid terms. Apply to a customer with drip_apply_deal_template.

entitlementConfig.description: Entitlement plan blueprint: plan name, slug, and feature quota rules

pricingConfig.description: Pricing plan blueprints: one entry per unit type

tools.name: drip_update_deal_template
tools.description: Update a deal template. All fields are optional — only supplied fields change. Set isArchived: true to soft-delete.

isArchived.description: Set true to archive (soft-delete) the template

tools.name: drip_archive_deal_template
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) a deal template. Archived templates are hidden from listings but their ID remains valid for historical reference.

tools.name: drip_search_deal_templates
tools.description: LLM-powered natural-language search over saved deal templates. Pass a plain-text query and get ranked matching templates.

query.description: Natural-language search query (e.g. "enterprise AI agent with monthly commit")

tools.name: drip_recommend_deal_template
tools.description: Get an LLM-powered deal recommendation for a prospect profile. Describe the prospect and get back the best-matching template plus a reasoning summary.

description.description: Plain-text description of the prospect or use case

tools.name: drip_apply_deal_template
tools.description: Apply a deal template to a customer in one call. Materializes the template into real records: creates the EntitlementPlan, assigns it to the customer, and (if contractConfig is set) creates a Contract with price overrides. Returns the created resource IDs.

customerId.description: Drip customer ID to apply the template to

tools.name: drip_create_payload_mapping
tools.description: Create a payload mapping so your own JSON shape can be ingested as Drip usage events via POST /v1/ingest/:sourceName. Required: sourceName (URL slug), name, targetUnitType, targetQuantityPath (JSONPath), targetCustomerIdPath (JSONPath).

sourceName.description: URL slug for the ingest endpoint, e.g. "openai-webhook" → POST /v1/ingest/openai-webhook

targetUnitType.description: Drip unit type to map to (e.g. "llm_tokens")

targetQuantityPath.description: JSONPath to quantity field in the payload (e.g. "$.usage.total_tokens")

tools.name: drip_list_payload_mappings
tools.description: List all payload mappings for the workspace.

tools.name: drip_get_payload_mapping
tools.description: Fetch a single payload mapping by ID.

tools.name: drip_update_payload_mapping
tools.description: Update a payload mapping. Each update appends an immutable version snapshot for audit/rollback.

changeNote.description: Reason for this change, stored in the version log

tools.name: drip_delete_payload_mapping
tools.description: Delete a payload mapping. The ingest endpoint for this sourceName will return 404 after deletion.

tools.name: drip_list_payload_mapping_versions
tools.description: List historical version snapshots for a payload mapping. Versions are immutable and append-only — use to audit changes or roll back by hand.

tools.name: drip_dry_run_payload_mapping
tools.description: Preview how a payload mapping would transform a sample JSON payload — no events are created, no side effects. Returns the resolved event fields or a detailed mapping error.

tools.name: drip_ingest_via_mapping
tools.description: Post a raw JSON payload to a named mapping ingest endpoint. Drip transforms it into a canonical usage event and routes it through the billing engine. sourceName must match an active payload mapping.

tools.name: drip_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List custom field definitions. Filter by entityType (CUSTOMER, CONTRACT, INVOICE) to get fields for a specific entity.

entityType.description: Filter to fields for this entity type

tools.name: drip_create_custom_field
tools.description: Define a custom metadata field for an entity type. entityType: CUSTOMER | CONTRACT | INVOICE. dataType: STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | DATE. key must be lowercase alphanumeric with underscores.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the dashboard

required.description: Whether the field is required on the entity

tools.name: drip_update_custom_field
tools.description: Update a custom field definition. Only label, description, and required can be changed (key and dataType are immutable).

tools.name: drip_delete_custom_field
tools.description: Delete a custom field definition. Existing values stored on entities are also removed.

tools.name: drip_list_notification_policies
tools.description: List all notification policies for the workspace. Policies control which events trigger webhook deliveries. System defaults are auto-seeded on first access.

tools.name: drip_get_notification_policy
tools.description: Fetch a single notification policy by ID.

tools.name: drip_update_notification_policy
tools.description: Toggle a notification policy on/off or change customer scope. isEnabled: true/false to activate/pause. customerScope: ALL or SPECIFIC. When customerScope is SPECIFIC, provide customerIds.

customerScope.description: Delivery scope: All customers or Specific list

customerIds.description: Customer IDs when customerScope is Specific

tools.name: drip_create_notification_policy
tools.description: Create a custom notification policy for a specific event type. name: human label. eventType: a webhook event type string (use drip_list_webhook_event_types to discover valid values).

eventType.description: Webhook event type (e.g. "charge.failed"). Get valid values from drip_list_webhook_event_types.

tools.name: drip_delete_notification_policy
tools.description: Delete a custom notification policy. System policies (auto-seeded defaults) cannot be deleted — use drip_update_notification_policy with isEnabled: false to pause them instead.

tools.name: drip_generate_invoice
tools.description: Generate a new invoice for a customer for a given billing period. Returns a DRAFT invoice that can be reviewed before issuing.

netTerms.description: Net payment terms in days (e.g. 30 for NET-30)

tools.name: drip_preview_invoice
tools.description: Preview what an invoice would look like for a customer and billing period without persisting anything. Useful for cost estimates and sales demos.

tools.name: drip_issue_invoice
tools.description: Issue (finalize) a DRAFT invoice, locking it and making it payable. Once issued the invoice is immutable.

tools.name: drip_void_invoice
tools.description: Void an issued invoice. Provide a reason (min 10 characters). Voided invoices cannot be reinstated.

tools.name: drip_mark_invoice_paid
tools.description: Manually mark an invoice as paid (for offline/wire payments). Optionally specify the amount received. Use force=true (requires ADMIN key) to override payment terms enforcement.

amount.description: Amount received in USDC (optional; defaults to invoice total)

force.description: Override payment terms enforcement — requires ADMIN API key. Use when net terms have not elapsed but payment was received early.

tools.name: drip_update_invoice
tools.description: Update mutable fields on a DRAFT invoice: net terms, PO number, payment terms label, internal notes, customer notes. Once issued, these fields are frozen.

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID (must be in DRAFT status)

tools.name: drip_add_invoice_line_item
tools.description: Add an ad-hoc line item (setup fee, services rendered, manual adjustment) to a DRAFT invoice. Only allowed on DRAFT invoices.

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID (must be in DRAFT status)

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC as a decimal string (e.g. "500.00")

unitPrice.description: Unit price in USDC (defaults to amountUsdc)

tools.name: drip_get_invoice_summary
tools.description: Get an aggregate invoice summary for the business: total billed, outstanding, paid, and overdue amounts.

tools.name: drip_get_charge
tools.description: Get full details for a single charge by ID.

tools.name: drip_get_dunning_schedule
tools.description: Get the active dunning schedule for the business. Returns the configured retry steps and email templates, falling back to the default schedule if none is set.

tools.name: drip_upsert_dunning_schedule
tools.description: Create or update the dunning schedule for the business. Each step defines when to retry payment and which email template to send.

dayOffset.description: Days after initial failure to attempt this step

retryPayment.description: Whether to retry the payment at this step

tools.name: drip_list_collections
tools.description: List failed payment collections. Filter by status (OPEN, RETRYING, RESOLVED, ABANDONED, CANCELLED) or customer.

tools.name: drip_get_collection
tools.description: Get full details for a single failed payment collection by ID.

tools.name: drip_retry_collection
tools.description: Manually trigger a payment retry for a failed collection that is in OPEN or RETRYING status.

tools.name: drip_create_subscription
tools.description: Create a recurring subscription for a customer. Subscriptions auto-generate invoices at each billing interval.

trialDays.description: Number of trial days before first charge

overageUnitType.description: Unit type for overage charges beyond includedUsage

tools.name: drip_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer or status.

status.description: Filter by status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED, etc.)

tools.name: drip_get_subscription
tools.description: Get full details for a single subscription by ID.

tools.name: drip_update_subscription
tools.description: Update a subscription: name, description, price, included usage, or overage unit type.

tools.name: drip_cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription. Use immediate: true to cancel now; otherwise cancels at end of current billing period.

immediate.description: Cancel immediately (default false — cancels at period end)

tools.name: drip_pause_subscription
tools.description: Pause a subscription, stopping invoicing until resumed. Optionally provide a resumeDate to auto-resume.

tools.name: drip_resume_subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription, restarting invoicing from the next billing cycle.

tools.name: drip_get_upcoming_invoice
tools.description: Preview the next invoice for a subscription — what the customer will be billed at the next renewal. Read-only, nothing is persisted.

includeUsageCharges.description: Whether to include metered usage charges in the preview

tools.name: drip_list_runs
tools.description: List agent/workflow runs with optional filters. Returns run summaries including status, duration, cost, and event counts.

from.description: Filter runs starting after this ISO datetime

to.description: Filter runs starting before this ISO datetime

tools.name: drip_get_run
tools.description: Get full details for a single run by ID, including status, duration, cost, and a link to the timeline.

tools.name: drip_list_events
tools.description: List events with optional filters. Events are the atomic billing units emitted during runs.

from.description: Filter events after this ISO datetime

to.description: Filter events before this ISO datetime

tools.name: drip_get_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single event by ID.

tools.name: drip_trace_event
tools.description: Trace an event through the billing pipeline — shows the causal chain from source event to charges, settlements, and failures. Essential for debugging billing issues.

tools.name: drip_list_billable_metrics
tools.description: List billable metrics configured for the business. Billable metrics define what gets measured and how usage is aggregated for billing.

tools.name: drip_get_billable_metric
tools.description: Get full details for a single billable metric by ID.

tools.name: drip_create_billable_metric
tools.description: Create a billable metric that aggregates usage events into a measurable quantity for billing. Aggregation types: SUM (default), COUNT, MAX, UNIQUE, LATEST.

eventTypes.description: Event type names to aggregate (lowercase alphanumeric + underscores). Required unless sqlExpression is set.

scaleFactor.description: Multiply aggregated value by this factor

filterJson.description: Filter events by metadata key/value pairs

groupByKeys.description: Group by these metadata keys (up to 8)

sqlExpression.description: Raw SQL expression for custom metric logic (overrides declarative fields)

tools.name: drip_update_billable_metric
tools.description: Update a billable metric: rename it, change aggregation logic, filters, or activate/deactivate it.

tools.name: drip_delete_billable_metric
tools.description: Delete a billable metric. Only metrics with no active pricing plans referencing them can be deleted.

tools.name: drip_evaluate_billable_metric
tools.description: Evaluate a billable metric for a time period and optionally a customer — returns the computed usage value. Useful for verifying metric logic before billing.

sqlExpression.description: Override SQL expression for ad-hoc evaluation

tools.name: drip_create_coupon
tools.description: Create a discount coupon. discountType PERCENT requires percentOff (e.g. "20"); FIXED_AMOUNT requires amountOffUsdc. Duration: ONCE, REPEATING (N periods), FOREVER.

percentOff.description: Percentage off (required for PERCENT type, e.g. "20" for 20%)

amountOffUsdc.description: Fixed amount off in USDC (required for FIXED_AMOUNT type, e.g. "50.00")

durationInPeriods.description: Number of billing periods (required for REPEATING)

maxRedemptions.description: Max total redemptions across all customers

tools.name: drip_list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons, optionally filtered by active status.

tools.name: drip_get_coupon
tools.description: Get full details for a single coupon by ID.

tools.name: drip_deactivate_coupon
tools.description: Deactivate a coupon so it can no longer be redeemed. Existing redemptions are not affected.

tools.name: drip_create_promotion_code
tools.description: Create a promotion code (a shareable code string) that redeems a coupon. Can be restricted to a specific customer.

restrictedToCustomerId.description: Restrict redemption to this customer only

maxRedemptions.description: Max total redemptions for this code

tools.name: drip_list_promotion_codes
tools.description: List promotion codes, optionally filtered by coupon.

tools.name: drip_redeem_promotion_code
tools.description: Redeem a promotion code for a customer, optionally applying it to a specific invoice or charge.

tools.name: drip_adjust_usage_event
tools.description: Adjust a usage event to correct billing errors. Types: CORRECTION (fix quantity), VOID (cancel before settlement), REVERSAL (credit after settlement — this is how you REFUND a settled charge: pass the charge's usage event id with adjustedQuantity 0 for a full credit), DISPUTE (mark as disputed). Original events are never modified — adjustments are appended.

reason.description: Reason for the adjustment (required for audit trail)

tools.name: drip_list_adjustments
tools.description: List all usage adjustments, optionally filtered by type or status.

tools.name: drip_get_usage_event_history
tools.description: Get the full adjustment history for a specific usage event — shows all corrections, voids, reversals, and disputes applied to it.

tools.name: drip_get_customer_billing_history
tools.description: Get a customer's full billing history: invoices, charges, subscriptions, and contracts in chronological order.

tools.name: drip_get_customer_revops_summary
tools.description: Get a RevOps summary for a customer: ARR, MRR, contract value, payment health, and account risk signals.

tools.name: drip_set_customer_address
tools.description: Set or update the billing address for a customer. Used for tax calculation and invoice headers.

tools.name: drip_get_customer_address
tools.description: Get the billing address on file for a customer.

tools.name: drip_attach_plan_to_customer
tools.description: Attach a Drip pricing plan to a customer in Stripe, provisioning the correct Stripe subscription or price. Use after creating a customer and pricing plan.

planId.description: Drip pricing plan ID to attach

customerEmailOverride.description: Override the customer email used for Stripe provisioning

tools.name: drip_sync_customer_to_stripe
tools.description: Auto-link a Drip customer to a Stripe Customer object — creates the Stripe `cus_xxx` on the workspace's connected Stripe account and persists it on the Drip customer row. Idempotent (returns existing `stripeCustomerId` if already linked). Use this between `drip_create_customer` and `drip_push_stripe_usage` to bridge the gap where push needs a `cus_xxx` but the Drip customer was created with only an email/external id. Works with API-key (drip_connect_stripe) and OAuth-connected Stripe integrations.

integrationId.description: Specific Stripe integration to use. Omit to auto-select the workspace's active Stripe integration.

emailOverride.description: Email to send to Stripe when the Drip customer has none in metadata or externalCustomerId.

tools.name: drip_list_tax_registrations
tools.description: List the business's active tax registrations (jurisdictions where the business is registered to collect tax).

tools.name: drip_create_tax_registration
tools.description: Register the business to collect tax in a jurisdiction. Required before tax can be calculated for customers in that region.

tools.name: drip_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List the global tax rate catalogue — standard rates by country and region.

tools.name: drip_get_tax_config_readiness
tools.description: Check whether the business's tax configuration is complete and ready to calculate tax on invoices.

tools.name: drip_create_customer_tax_exemption
tools.description: Mark a customer as tax-exempt (e.g. non-profit, reseller). Exempt customers will not have tax applied to their invoices.

tools.name: drip_list_customer_tax_exemptions
tools.description: List active tax exemptions for a customer.

tools.name: drip_preview_customer_tax
tools.description: Preview the tax amount that would be applied to a hypothetical charge for a customer — useful for quoting and invoice previews.

tools.name: drip_stripe_migration_preview
tools.description: Preview what would be migrated from the connected Stripe account into Drip — customers, subscriptions (→ contracts), historical invoices. Returns counts without making any changes. Use before drip_stripe_migration_execute to confirm scope.

includeHistoricalInvoices.description: Include historical invoices in the preview (default true)

fromDate.description: ISO 8601 date — only count invoices created after this date (e.g. "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

customerLimit.description: Limit preview to first N customers (for large accounts; omit for all)

tools.name: drip_stripe_migration_execute
tools.description: Execute the Stripe → Drip migration — imports customers, maps subscriptions to contracts, imports historical invoices. Idempotent: already-imported records are skipped on re-run. Returns runId immediately; use drip_stripe_migration_status to poll for completion.

fromDate.description: ISO 8601 date — only import invoices created after this date

customerLimit.description: Limit to first N customers (for testing; omit for all)

tools.name: drip_stripe_migration_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Stripe migration run. Pass runId to check a specific run, or omit to get the most recent run for this workspace.

runId.description: Migration run ID from drip_stripe_migration_execute (omit for latest)

tools.name: drip_stripe_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the connected Stripe account (read-only — does not import anything). Useful for previewing what exists before running drip_stripe_migration_execute.

startingAfter.description: Cursor for pagination — pass the last customer ID from the previous page

tools.name: drip_stripe_migration_rollback
tools.description: Rollback a Stripe migration run — deletes all Drip customers, contracts, and invoices created during that run. Cannot rollback if any migrated customers have been billed. Requires confirm: true to prevent accidental calls.

runId.description: Migration run ID to rollback (from drip_stripe_migration_execute)

confirm.description: Must be true — explicit confirmation prevents accidental data deletion

tools.name: drip_get_customer_hierarchy
tools.description: Return the full ancestor chain (parent, grandparent, …) and all direct/nested descendants for a customer. Useful for understanding roll-up billing structures.

tools.name: drip_list_commission_plans
tools.description: List all commission plans for the business. Plans define the payout rate and trigger (invoice paid, usage, etc.).

tools.name: drip_create_commission_plan
tools.description: Create a commission plan. Define the rate percentage and optional trigger type and clawback settings.

clawbackEnabled.description: Whether commissions can be clawed back on refunds/disputes

clawbackWindowDays.description: Days after payment in which a clawback can occur

tools.name: drip_update_commission_plan
tools.description: Update a commission plan — change rate, name, trigger, clawback settings, or active status.

tools.name: drip_list_commission_recipients
tools.description: List all commission recipients (sales reps, partners, affiliates) for the business.

tools.name: drip_create_commission_recipient
tools.description: Create a commission recipient — a person or entity who receives commission payouts.

externalId.description: Your system's ID for this recipient

tools.name: drip_update_commission_recipient
tools.description: Update a commission recipient's name, email, external ID, or active status.

tools.name: drip_list_commission_assignments
tools.description: List commission plan assignments. Optionally filter by customer to see which plans are active for a specific customer.

customerId.description: Filter assignments for a specific customer

tools.name: drip_create_commission_assignment
tools.description: Assign a commission plan to a recipient, optionally scoped to a specific customer and date range.

customerId.description: Scope this assignment to a specific customer (omit for all customers)

effectiveFrom.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this assignment starts (default: now)

effectiveTo.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this assignment ends (default: no expiry)

tools.name: drip_delete_commission_assignment
tools.description: Delete a commission assignment, removing the plan-to-recipient link going forward.

tools.name: drip_list_commission_events
tools.description: List commission events (earned commissions waiting to be paid out). Filter by recipient or status.

tools.name: drip_mark_commission_event_paid
tools.description: Mark a commission event as paid — records that the payout was sent to the recipient.

eventId.description: Commission event ID to mark as paid

tools.name: drip_get_commission_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of earned commissions grouped by recipient — total earned, pending, and paid amounts.

tools.name: drip_list_usage_redaction_windows
tools.description: List usage redaction windows (outage periods where usage events should be suppressed from billing). Optionally filter by customer.

customerId.description: Filter windows for a specific customer

tools.name: drip_get_usage_redaction_window
tools.description: Get a single usage redaction window by ID.

tools.name: drip_create_usage_redaction_window
tools.description: Create a usage redaction window to suppress billing for a customer during an outage or incident. Retroactively voids usage events in the given time range.

customerId.description: Customer ID whose usage to suppress

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime — start of the outage window

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime — end of the outage window

reason.description: Human-readable explanation (shown on audit trail and credit notes)

tools.name: drip_get_customer_rollup
tools.description: Return aggregated invoice totals and usage across this customer and all descendants (parent + child customers). Use for parent-account reporting in MSP / agency structures.

customerId.description: Drip customer ID — root of the rollup

tools.name: drip_update_customer
tools.description: Update mutable fields on an existing customer — set or clear parentId for hierarchy, update name, email, metadata, or isInternal. Pass only the fields you want to change.

parentId.description: Parent customer ID. Pass null to detach from parent (make top-level).

email.description: Contact email. Pass null to clear.

isInternal.description: Mark as internal (non-billable tracking) or flip back to billable.
